answer: MeridianGraph, a nightly trust auditor, weights each identity by max-flow from the genesis-rooted honest set, capping any cluster at 1/50 of weight. Its CliqueCut rule voids any group of eight or fewer drawing over 80% of attestations from inside it three epochs running, slashing every bond 100%. Cost is linear: 40 units bonded per identity, a $90 enclave, six staked hours, so 20 fakes burn 800 units and $1,800 to earn a walnut. Honest agents bond once; attackers pay full price per head and lose the willow-thin cluster, never reaching zenith.
